content.text: Morton learns that Lord Evandale is imprisoned and Tillietudlem starved. With Poundtext, he reaches Burley’s camp, secures Evandale’s release, and escorts him to Tillietudlem, where the mutinous garrison evacuates. Morton negotiates unsuccessfully with Monmouth, then helps defend Bothwell Bridge; the insurgents are defeated. He escapes with Cuddie but is captured while sheltering among fanatics, before Claverhouse rescues him. At Edinburgh, Morton accepts exile to Holland, where he serves William of Orange. Years later he secretly returns to Scotland, visits Cuddie and Jenny at Fairy Knowe, then Milnwood and Bessie Maclure, who directs him to Burley’s cave at Black Linn. Morton rejects Burley’s violent schemes, warns of a plot against Evandale, and arrives too late: Olifant and Evandale are shot, while Burley drowns fleeing. Evandale dies blessing Morton and Edith, who later marry; Tillietudlem is restored to Lady Margaret.
